notes.title: Leaf Town is Now Officially Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm Ye Yu, the developer of Leaf Town.

After a long period of polishing and testing, Leaf Town is officially launching today!
This is a farm management game with roguelike elements.
From the initial prototype to today’s full release, I want to sincerely thank every player who supported the game, joined the playtest, or added it to their wishlist.

The game is now available for purchase, with a 15% launch discount during the first week.
If you enjoy simulation, strategic placement, and planning your builds carefully—this game is made for you!

Key Features

    100+ plot effects to explore—place strategically to earn more coins and bonuses

    Nearly 100 tools with unique mechanics to build your own playstyle

    8 uniquely designed maps, each with its own rules and environmental challenges

    Fast-paced gameplay—finish a full run in just around 20 minutes

The development of Leaf Town has taken over a year from concept to completion.
I'm thrilled to finally share it with you, and deeply grateful for all the feedback, suggestions, and encouragement along the way.

If you encounter any issues while playing, or if you'd like to share your thoughts and ideas, feel free to join our Discord community:
https://discord.gg/nkUhAWenrf

Thank you again for your support. I hope Leaf Town brings you a relaxing and rewarding farming experience!

— Ye Yu

notes.title: Leaf Town Releases on May 22
notes.content:
[b]Leaf Town Releases on May 22![/b]

Hello everyone! Thank you to all the players following Leaf Town!

After a great run during Steam Next Fest, we received tons of valuable feedback and saw a solid boost in wishlists. Seeing the excitement from players, we’re happy to announce that Leaf Town will be released on May 22!

[b]What's New in the Full Release?[/b]

    More Maps – Expanding from the 3 maps in the demo, the full release adds 5 brand-new maps with fresh challenges and strategic depth.
    New Playable Characters – Two additional characters with unique traits, bringing more ways to play.
    Improvements & Balancing – Based on player feedback, we’ve fine-tuned game balance, interactions, and overall gameplay experience.

[b]The Demo is Still Available – Try It Now![/b]
Haven’t played Leaf Town yet? The demo is still live! Jump in now to get a taste of the game and share your thoughts. We’ll keep refining things before launch.

[b]Release Date: May 22, 2025[/b]
Add Leaf Town to your wishlist and don’t miss the launch! Thanks for all your support—we’ll see you on May 22!

— Leaf Town Developer, Ye Yu

notes.title: Leaf Town Demo Now Available – Experience It Today
notes.content:
In this Demo version, players will be able to experience the following:

Open Farm Management
Plan and organize your farm freely by constructing a variety of buildings and tools. Use strategic combinations to maximize profits and create a unique town of your own.

Rich Tools and Resources
The demo includes over 100 plots and tools, allowing you to experiment with different combinations and explore various strategies.

Core Gameplay Experience
The demo provides access to the first three major maps of the game, along with the Lumberjack character. Explore unique environments and discover strategies tailored to each.
Notes

    The demo showcases the core gameplay, while the full version will include more characters, maps, and tools.
    Save data in the demo is exclusive to this version. Whether save data can be carried over to the full version will depend on future development plans.
    Stay Updated: Add Leaf Town to your Steam wishlist for updates, or join our Discord at https://discord.gg/VYxCskpsXv to follow development progress and connect with other players!

Thank you for your support! We look forward to hearing your feedback!

notes.title: Leaf Town Regular Update Announcement 11.11
notes.content:
New Content

Two new characters join the game, making farm planning easier!

    Worker
        Skill: The Worker can convert one "Nature" plot on the map into a basic machine, greatly improving farm efficiency.
        Starting Tool: The Worker’s machines have an initial range covering the surrounding area, providing support to nearby crops and facilities.

    Merchant
        Skill: The Merchant can transform a "Nature" plot into a random resource, adding variety to your resource pool.
        Starting Tool: The Merchant starts with three resources of the same tag but different quality, enjoying an additional 10% bonus! This provides more opportunities for extra profits!

Bug Fixes

    Fixed inaccuracies in some English localizations to ensure an optimal experience for players worldwide.

Optimizations

    Improved the clarity of game guidance, making it easier for new players to get started and helping veteran players better understand new features.
    Updated related sound effects to add a more lively atmosphere, enhancing the immersive experience!


Thank you for your support, and enjoy your journey in Leaf Town, where farm management meets strategic exploration!

notes.title: Leaf Town - Farm Management Game Now Open for Testing!
notes.content:
Leaf Town is a creative, strategy-driven farm management game with rich roguelike elements, offering diverse gameplay. You'll build a ranch town by purchasing and strategically placing farm structures, exploring map expansions, and maximizing earnings for a unique experience in every session. Currently, the game includes nearly 200 plot items, 100 tools, 8 maps, and a selectable character, allowing for endless gameplay combinations.

In the test version, players can experience fully randomized map layouts, building options, and item selections each round. Every turn comes with a target income goal, which you can reach by carefully choosing structures and placing them for bonus effects. By meeting these goals, you unlock further features, and accumulated item effects will further boost your building income, helping you take on higher income challenges!

Test Announcement Notes:
    Application method: Access the test periodically through the store page (or join our Discard server to request an activation code).
    Independent Saves: Save data for the test version does not carry over to the official release.
    Test Period: Testing is open from today until the official launch, with some temporary closures to align with special events.
    Stay Updated: Add Leaf Town to your Steam wishlist for updates, Or join our Discord at https://discord.gg/VYxCskpsXv to follow development progress and connect with other players!

Thank you for your support, and enjoy your journey in Leaf Town, where farm management meets strategic exploration!
